title: Urdais Photonics — PH-2 data feasibility audit matrix
status: internal research; establishes no legal right; selects no methodology; writes no code, migration, schema or ingestion

feasibility_states.VIABLE: evidence indicates Urdais could build and maintain this path under currently known conditions
feasibility_states.CONDITIONALLY_VIABLE: technically plausible; one or more explicit unresolved conditions must be satisfied
feasibility_states.BLOCKED_RIGHTS: data exists but Urdais lacks demonstrated rights for the intended product
feasibility_states.BLOCKED_DATA: required observations do not appear obtainable at adequate grain, history or cadence
feasibility_states.BLOCKED_ECONOMICS: a real path exists but demonstrated cost makes it unsuitable under current Urdais constraints
feasibility_states.FALSIFIED: evidence shows the data path does not measure the claimed economic object
feasibility_states.UNKNOWN: evidence insufficient; not converted to BLOCKED merely because information is private

settled_ph1_constraints: nominal data rate alone is not a sufficient product identity
no daily or weekly professional optical-transceiver pricing found; quarterly must not be interpolated to synthetic daily
client/datacom optics and coherent DCI are separate economic markets
product ontology and economic observation are separate layers
public government datasets cannot set a transceiver ASP level

specification_key.principle: smallest field set that prevents non-substitutes from entering one stratum; minimality matters because thin strata are the merchant panel's main failure mode

reconstruction_risk.mechanism: each published aggregate is one linear equation in N unknown weights with known coefficients (the published sub-index relatives); over T periods within a fixed-weight window, T >= N makes the weight vector exactly solvable

merchant_probe.method: two evidence sets, both 2026-09-23. Set 1 (this pass): transport-layer probes, robots.txt first, one request per URL, browser UA or curl, no retries against bot managers, NO PRICE COLLECTED. Set 2 (parallel PH-2A pass): terms pages read in full and selected product pages fetched including prices. Set 2 supersedes Set 1 on conflict — reading a contract beats failing to fetch one.

merchant_probe.finding: prices are available; the licence to use them is not. Both merchants whose terms have been read (FS.com, DigiKey) prohibit BOTH the collection method AND publication of the result, each naming written consent as the route through. A substantial set of price-publishing merchants (CDW, Vitex, FiberMall, LINK-PP, Mouser, Arrow, Avnet) have UNREAD terms — UNKNOWN, not blocked, and the only direction in which Candidate A advances without a negotiation.
merchant_probe.specification_fidelity_finding: PH-2A manual SKU pilot: merchant listings frequently omit retiming architecture (Vitex 800G DR8 page says neither LPO nor retimed) and the merchant label 'FR' is not one cell. Key field 4 is NOT reliably derivable from public listing text — gate A-6 failing on first contact with real data.

what_ph2_changed: the merchant blocker moved from unknown to documented, and its shape changed: FS.com's and DigiKey's terms forbid scraping AND derivative publication without written consent. The blocker is a contract, not availability — prices are fetchable — and it is therefore negotiable. The surviving route is the price-publishing merchants whose terms nobody has read yet.
the comparison key is shorter than the field list suggests: reach, fiber, wavelength plan and lane count are already inside the PMD designation — eight fields, not sixteen
the hybrid architecture has a specific arithmetic disclosure risk (weight reconstruction) that must be raised with a provider rather than discovered by one
merchant listings do not reliably state retiming architecture, so key field 4 cannot be populated from public listing text alone
compliance_disclosure: One automated request in this pass fetched a PDF under omdia.tech.informa.com/-/media/. Omdia's robots.txt, re-read the same day, places ClaudeBot and Claude-User under Disallow: /. That request was contrary to Omdia's stated policy. No content was extracted and nothing from it is used. No further automated request to that domain beyond robots.txt should be made; the correct route is citations@omdia.com.
stop_condition: PH-2 ends with feasibility states and entry gates. No methodology selected, no candidate ranked, no version assigned, no production code, migration, schema or ingestion, UPPI demo untouched, nothing committed.
